notes: Where the ground-cover shader (game/resources/materials/world/ground_cover/ground_cover.gdshader) draws a recipe over a record's own family: tools/lib/ground-cover-map.mjs draws these rules into the world map game/resources/textures/world/ground_cover/cover_map.png (rebuild it with tools/build_ground_cover_map.mjs after the world or this file changes). Coordinates are world metres: +X east, +Z south.

Channels name the recipe families of game/scripts/world/ground_cover.gd: lawn (maintained lawn with some dry patches), straw (dry straw grass), dry_field (dry grass with much bare ground) and bare (bare fill soil with a little dry grass). A rule's weight covers what the rules before it drew (in order), so later rules win.

within_sources limits a rule to the cells whose top drawn ground is that OSM area; surfaces to the cells whose top drawn ground has that material key; within_xz to a traced polygon whose edge fades over feather_m; near to within full_m of buildings, vehicle roads, lots or street kerbs, fading out by zero_m; shore to within full_m of the island outline, fading out by zero_m; weight scales the rule.

Look anchored to the 2026-05-26 aerial (Wayback release 2026-10-29, Vantor Vivid Advanced, 0.34 m, the late-spring dry fields), with the 2025-08-29 aerial and dated Street View as corroboration. Widths, distances and traced outlines are production inference, not survey data; OSM and the imagery are offset 3-6 m, so traced outlines follow the OSM buildings beside them.

rules.reason: The residential grounds away from the buildings and streets are dry straw grass in late spring, the shore belt beside the riprap included; the band rule below draws the lawns over it.
rules.evidence: 2026-05-26 aerial over r17241151 (inventory heuristic classes, 1 m cells): more than 14 m from buildings, roads and lots the open ground is 85-97 % dry grass, 4-8 % lawn and 3-9 % bare, open-ground mean sRGB about (126,116,87); within 50 m of the outline 78-92 % dry. The 2025-08-29 aerial is drier still (Z1 lawn 4.8 % of the zone). Street View in Mar 2025 (sv05, 1236 Northpoint Dr) shows the same belt green after the winter rains; the game keeps the late-spring look of the 2026-10-17 ground-cover decision.

rules.reason: The housing keeps a patchy maintained lawn round its buildings, along its streets and round its parking lots, fading into the dry grounds about 12 m out; weight 0.7 leaves the straw underneath showing through as the lawn's dry patches.
rules.evidence: 2026-05-26 aerial over r17241151, by distance from buildings, vehicle roads and lots: lawn is 31-33 % of the open ground at 2-6 m, 18 % at 8-10 m, 11 % at 12-14 m and 5-7 % beyond 14 m (the rest mostly dry), open-ground mean about (120,123,90) at 4-8 m. Crops a19-nw-residential and a19-west-central (2026-05-26); Street View Mar 2025 sv04 (1230 Gateview Ct): mown lawn along the court and the units.

rules.reason: The open lawn inside the Northpoint loop, west of the two row houses, is mown green well beyond the band.
rules.evidence: 2026-05-26 aerial (crop z1-oval, x -400..-170, z -720..-600): lawn 69 % of the open ground inside this outline.

rules.reason: East of the row houses the loop's lawn is half green, half dry, round the old sand court.
rules.evidence: 2026-05-26 aerial (crop z1-oval): lawn 50 %, dry 48 % of the open ground inside this outline.

rules.reason: A mown lawn beside the loop road's west bend, beyond the band.
rules.evidence: 2026-05-26 aerial: lawn 68 % of the open ground inside this outline.

rules.reason: The Job Corps campus is dry grass but for the irrigated lawn between the west and middle wings of Dormitory 369; traced between the OSM wings.
rules.evidence: 2026-05-26 aerial (crop jc-dorms, 5 m grid): lawn 82 % of the open ground between the wings; the rest of the campus is 79 % dry and 20 % bare (big north field).

rules.reason: East of Building 1 the Marina Plaza area is a bare graded field, not a lawn.
rules.evidence: 2026-05-26 aerial (crop south-parks, x -170..140, z 680..950): bare 86 % of the open ground inside this outline, pale (about 195,190,167).

rules.reason: The synthetic-turf pitch (family turf) has a pale paved apron about 12 m wide along its south-west side and 10 m along its south-east side, inside the OSM outline.
rules.evidence: 2026-05-26 aerial (crop turf, x 140..320, z -280..-110): pale apron with benches along the two sides; the turf fills the rest of the outline.

rules.reason: The industrial core's unbuilt land is dry grass with much bare ground and almost no green.
rules.evidence: 2026-05-26 aerial, default land in 200 m boxes over x -200..400, z -400..-200: lawn 2-6 %, dry 10-30 %, bare 51-86 % of the open ground; vegetation inventory zone Z7 (x -160..380, z -460..-90).

rules.reason: The verge between Avenue N and the seawall riprap, where the date palms stand, is dry straw (the strip 2-30 m right of OSM w8921530 from about z 200 to its north end).
rules.evidence: Street View Nov 2025 pano ttrmGi5rdijqAHRqMz7bsQ (505 Avenue N, refs sv02/sv03): straw verge with a few green tufts; aerials 2026-05-26 (a19-east-avN-strip) and 2025-08-29 (a20-east-seawall-row): brown verge under the palm row.
